pages.text: $(li)Big TPS offenders: TR machines, Cyclic, itemducts, and large conduit bundles.$(li)Keep auto-farms outside every player's render distance (e.g., in Compact Machines or the Void Dimension).

$(li)Don't put XU Mechanical Users next to SFM inventory managers, their cables, or AE2 cables—it causes severe lag.$(li)To reduce AE2 lag from many storage buses: subnet the drawer walls, use partitioned or void cells, and keep drives in extract-only subnets.

$(li)The Autoinfuser speed upgrade gives +80% speed (1.8×), not 80×.$(li)Use Immersive Engineering chutes instead of Open Crates for item transport—Open Crates cause measurable lag while idle.$(li)Avoid over-relying on Subnet Proxies;

they only help with cell count and channel management, not raw performance, and may slightly increase lag.$(li)For Ender IO conduits: minimize item types per channel, avoid filtering at output blocks (use EIO filters instead), and bundle conduits sparingly.
Consider replacing energy conduits with Draconic Evolution wireless crystals.
